name: Music Player
tagline: Control YouTube Music from the toolbar, or in a floating Mini Player.

sections.heading: Music without leaving your work
sections.body: A music button appears in the toolbar while a YouTube Music tab is open. Its card shows the song, artwork and time bar, with play and pause, next, previous and 10-second skip buttons. Controls play in that tab; nothing runs while the player is closed.
bullets: Play, next, previous and 10-second skips are also in Cmd+P
Starting music in one tab pauses the others (you can turn this off in settings)
Optional notification when the song changes, with the cover art

sections.heading: Mini Player
sections.body: Open a floating player from the Music card or Cmd+P. It never takes focus, remembers its place and screen, and can stay above other windows.
bullets: Themes: Glass, Tiger, Grey and Old Is New
The volume slider sets the Mac system volume
It hides while there is no YouTube Music tab
